responsibility: This file implements GCC’s simple dense bitmap operations and utilities. It provides allocation and resizing of sbitmap objects and vectors, core boolean operations and combined dataflow idioms, range set/clear support, bit counting and search, dumping and debug printers, and selftests for range queries. Its responsibility is the concrete implementation of the lightweight fixed-universe bitmap type widely used by older dataflow and RTL algorithms.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the out-of-line implementation for the sbitmap API declared in gcc/sbitmap.h, providing allocation, resizing, set algebra, dumping, and checking-only selftests rather than defining the bitmap type, macros, inline bit accessors, iterator, and RAII wrapper.
